messages:
samir.k: Heads-up: launching Dedicated 'Aurora-V' pools in europe-west3 (paris-2) as a reserved-preview. Provisioning window: 2026-05-03 14:00-16:00 UTC. Docs/quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/aurora-paris
rachel.prod: Is this GA or preview? What are access rules?
samir.k: Reserved-preview only for first 72h. Existing Dedicated customers may request migration; self-serve reservations will be enabled after stabilization.
ops-bot: @channel Provisioning scheduled 2026-05-03 14:00-16:00 UTC. Expect minor CA rebalancing. No planned customer downtime.
olivia.sales: Sales note: pls do not promise self-serve capacity until we announce the open-reservations flag. We will share quota guidance in the product bulletin.
samir.k: Hardware summary: Aurora-V = 160 TF infer-class (codename Aurora-V), 192GB HBM, tuned kernels for long-context KV caching and mixed-precision. Early perf: ~1.5x throughput vs our H100 baseline on long-context workloads. See docs link for details.
devex: Will the Console surface migration tuning recommendations?
samir.k: Yes 1Console will include a migration checklist and recommended batch/kv cache settings. Quick autoscale snippet for infra teams:
```
# aurora-paris autoscale example
pool: aurora-paris-2
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 12
burst_slots: 2
default_replica_cap_per_tenant: 3
```
sre-oncall: Ops constraints: default cap 3 replicas per tenant during preview to reduce noisy-neighbor risk. Cross-zone burst fallback disabled for first 48h. If customers need >3, submit infra-ops with justification.
olivia.sales: Billing: per-token pricing unchanged, but a temporary 8% "aurora_preview" uplift will apply to early reserved commitments to offset provisioning costs. Reverted after GA.
rachel.prod: Any SLA differences for reserved customers?
samir.k: No SLA changes. We will explicitly call out preview isolation and temporary caps in the customer bulletin.
ops-bot: Reminder: post-launch checks will include tail-latency dashboards, KV cache hit-rate, and eviction events. Tag @sre-oncall if you see 5xx increases or tail latency spikes.
devex: I'll add a one-click quickstart and troubleshooting cheat-sheet to the Console flow. Please review the bulletin draft in #eng-runtime.
olivia.sales: Acked. We'll hold outbound comms until the bulletin publishes.
samir.k: Thanks team 6A; if anything goes sideways during provisioning ping @sre-oncall immediately.
